data.text:
Rajesh Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand ..... ... ... on 12 April, 
2024 
Author: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
Bench: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 A.B.A. No. 1105 of 2024
 Rajesh Kumar ..... ... Petitioner
 Versus
 The State of Jharkhand ..... ... Opposite Pa
 --------
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi 
------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Lalan Kumar Singh, Advocate. 
 For the State : Mr. S.K. Verma, A.P.P.
 ------
04/ 12.04.2024 Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and learned
 A.P.P. for the State. 
2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Ramgarh P.S. Case No. 234 of 2023,
for the alleged offences under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in
the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ramgarh. 
3.  Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was authorized to enter the name of the persons, who are intended to apply for the Food Safety Mitra. He submits that petitioner is nothing to do with any forged license. He further submits that only false allegations are made against the petitioner and with regard to authorization, he refers to Annexures-2 and 3 of the petition. 
4. Learned A.P.P. for the State has opposed the prayer on the ground that the petitioner's involvement is there in issuing the license with regard to food safety. 
5. From Annexures-2 and 3 it transpires that the petitioner is authorized to make entry online and this petitioner has only entered the name of the persons, who are willing to obtain the license with regard to food safety and how this petitioner is involved, prima facie, is not disclosed in the FIR. 
6. In view of the attending facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner. Accordingly, he is directed to surrender before the learned court within three weeks from today and in the event of his surrender / arrest, the petitioner, named above, shall be Rajesh Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand ..... ... ... on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41140832/
1 released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (twenty-five thousand), with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ramgarh, in connection with Ramgarh P.S. Case No. 234 of 2023, subject to conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure. 
(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Amitesh/-
